scope: Focused primary-source review, not exhaustive proof of novelty or absence

sources.title: DroneMD
sources.finding: Repository describes GPU JAX/MuJoCo drone physics, Boids motion and Three.js visualization. Readme claims are not independently reproduced; this is prior overlap, not a benchmark comparison.

sources.title: Crazyflow
sources.finding: 2026 primary paper reports GPU-accelerated drone simulation and physical experiments. Counts of many independent worlds cannot be equated to one interacting swarm.

sources.title: DOP SIM
sources.finding: Existing data-oriented quadrotor simulator with downwash support; needs model-specific accuracy comparison.

sources.title: Neural-Swarm2
sources.finding: Learned multirotor interactions and planning/control already studied; a new model needs held-out evidence.

sources.title: Influence of Static and Dynamic Downwash Interactions on Multi-Quadrotor Systems
sources.finding: Measured force/moment and flow under fixed experimental motor conditions. Matching raw-data validation was not completed.

sources.title: Brown dataset DOI
sources.finding: Retrieval tool returned inaccessible on 2026-10-11. This is a tool/access limitation, not evidence of nonexistence.

sources.title: Modeling Aggregate Downwash Forces for Dense Multirotor Flight
sources.finding: Aggregate effects require validation; no direct multi-source validation oracle established in this project.

sources.title: Robotics meets Fluid Dynamics
sources.finding: Mean jet airflow model does not itself establish rotor force response or turbulent forcing for this vehicle.

sources.title: Resolved Brown repository landing page
sources.finding: Resolved through public DataCite DOI metadata; ordinary repository GET returned HTTP 403. No raw dataset validation performed.
